source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Download the bridge maintenance checklist.
3. Open bridge maintenance checklist and select the area you are inspecting.
4. Walk out to the bridge.
5. Inspect each part or area for defects.
6. Take photos of the defects.
7. Note the location of the defect.
8. Note the type of defect.
9. Estimate the amount of the defect.
10. Make recommendations for repairs.

Following these instructions will help you accurately document the structural defects in a bridge maintenance report.
